notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows the arm9/MaterialChanger and arm9/dCcAc_c entries, which took the same route.

Model is the concrete model class (cartridge dExtSimpleModel_c): an embedded ModelComponents plus a mat4x3 it multiplies into a stack temp for Render, a transformsBuf it sizes from the BMD file, and the four virtuals the vtable lists.

This run carries the class's complete lifecycle: the cartridge homes D2, D0, D1 AND C1, C2, the exact five-variant order one ~Model() plus one Model() emits under deferred codegen, so every emitted function enrols and nothing deadstrips.
The file is written ROM-descending because mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order under default deferred codegen; the emitted object carries the nine functions ascending 0x02016b78..0x02016df8.

The cartridge spells this class dExtSimpleModel_c and its vtable is homed under the project spelling _ZTV5Model at 0x0208e90c, so _ZTS/_ZTI records emitted under the project's Model spelling would have no configured ROM home. This TU therefore compiles with #pragma RTTI off, the same lever the merged ShadowModel and MaterialChanger folds use for the identical dExt* coined-name situation: no RTTI records are emitted, and the vtable preamble's typeinfo word deadstrips with the rest of the .data output.

common.h precedes Model.h so this TU sees the flat Matrix4x3 { s32 m[12]; } spelling: the ctor's `mat4x3 = IDENTITY_MATRIX4X3` block-moves twelve words under it, where the structured Matrix3x3+Vector3 spelling scalarizes into a longer sequence. Virtual10 keeps the same flat view for its twelve-word copy into data.transforms.
